name: blood pressure readings are a time-series, not a conflict
description: Two BP readings on different days are measurements: both stay active, NO supersession, NO false conflict (docs/reference/ANALYSIS.md fact kinds: measurement = time-series, accumulate, never auto-supersede). A third reading taken the SAME day/instant as the second but with a different value is a same-instant disagreement -> the candidate lands pending_review and a fact_conflict is filed for a human to pick.
xfail: ACCEPTED, on measurement. assert_fact has no `kind` field, and none of this scenario's predicates is declared in the tier-1 registry, so `_fact_kind` falls back to the subject type's default (`attribute` for a Person). An attribute holds a second value for review, so what was a measurement time-series or a clean state supersession is now an attribute_collision. A `kind` field was probed against the live model (evals/shape_probe.py, `fields` suite, gpt-oss-120b, 12 samples an arm): described with its six words in an imperative 'copy exactly ONE of these six words, and never any other word', it came back legal 7 times in 80 - the model writes the fact's TOPIC (`residence` x15, `employment` x10, `medical` x9, `weight` x5) - and 12 in 85 on the full eleven-field surface. Required buys presence, not membership. The route that does work is the one `_fact_kind` already reads: DECLARE the predicate in `src/jbrain/schema/defs/`, where a declared `kind` wins over the subject type's default. That is registry work under ENTITY_GRAPH_REFOCUS_PLAN's tier-1, not tool work. The one enum-free shape that CAN carry a closed vocabulary was tried too and fails the other way round: a `reading` BOOLEAN (is this a number off an instrument?) came back legal 96 times in 96 and `true` 88 of them - on 'Dana still works at Everlane' and 'I finally sold the Civic' alike - so wiring it would make nearly every fact a measurement, which accumulates and never supersedes. The mirror image of the `negated` boolean, which never fires at all. W5 MUST NOT DELETE: `_fact_kind`, the registry's per-predicate `kind` declaration, or the `attribute_collision` card - it is the only thing standing between an undeclared measurement and a silent overwrite.
